title: EIA Open Data: petroleum daily prices
author: U.S. Energy Information Administration

chunks.heading: Coverage
chunks.body: EIA Open Data includes daily petroleum spot and futures prices and presents the service as free open data subject to its reuse policy.

chunks.heading: Campaign fit
chunks.body: WTI Cushing daily spot is a defensible discovery proxy for the economic driver, but it still requires overlap parity against Ostium CL-USD before candidate promotion.
